reviews.x: You can buy this product at a store for half the price

reviews.t: Thickness doesn't equate to more soap
reviews.x: The scent is fine,  it's definitely a thick body wash, however that thickness doesn't seem to equate to more soap.  It doesn't seem to be any better than any other body wash. Yet they charge more.  So not going to purchase again
You can get this for 9 bucks off of their website. This is a total ripoff.

If you like a rustic, country, leather smell, with a bit of tobacco. This is it! It’s cruelty-free. Decent size and price point. Has Aloe-Vera.  It’s not Woke like other mainstream companies out there. They donate to to Veterans. While respecting and honoring what a real Man is.

reviews.t: Mmmmmm who smells like a sexy forest?
reviews.x: I will only use this body wash for the rest of my life!!! It’s thicker than Kim Kardashian’s trunk so you only need a little bit. You come out of the shower smelling like a sexy tree.

Decent soap.  Got me clean but the smell wasn't great and the bottling is terrible. The soap is very thick, as advertised, but it isn't easily squeezed from the massive bottle/tiny opening. Thankfully, I was able to keep my Man Card and develop a system of levers and pulleys to increase the force in my grip required to dispense this product onto my free hand.  After it was gone, I returned to cleansers that human beings of normal strength and ability can utilize. And again, not a fan of the smel

I bought this product along with others for my son, he's a Marine.  He loves the scent, and especially since it's a veterans product.  Lets support U.S products from our veterans!!  He loves the scent and the description on the products are cool as well.  Great product!!
I bought old glory..the wife says i smell like a cedar fence and my friend says i smell like an old barn filled with tobacco leaves ..lmfao

reviews.t: Good body wash but the scent is very low
reviews.x: As most my reviews on body wash, I always state; hard water takes more soap then moderate to soft water, to lather. In this case, I can use very little, like maybe a bit less than a table spoon on my loofah (yes I do use one) and can lather this Greek bod from toes to head no problem.  The smell is there but for me, not very strong at all.  I like the scent and whish it was a bit stronger. This is not a deodorant soap, so it does not leave a scent on the skin after drying off. The bottle is huge, and you get a lot of wash out of it for $9. The scent, while masculine, is a little confusing. It isn't bad, you just aren't really certain what it it is. I've figured it out: cedar chips from the pet store. The ones you put in the bottom of your kids hamster or rabbit cage. Like i said, not bad. Just realize you're going to smell a pet store.

I love a good smelling body wash on my partner, but especially the kind where I can use it too and feel saucy.  This is spicy, while somehow a little soft and yummy to wear as a woman.  I love the thickness, which leaves my skin super soft.  As for my boyfriend, he loves it and the scent lingers on him for an hour or two after using, which for me is divine.

My oldest son works as an auto mechanic in a shop In North Carolina. It’s a job that he loves but also one where he gets very dirty and, especially during our very hot summers, very sweaty and smelly. This is the only body wash I’ve found that he says makes him feel and smell really clean after work. The scent is great, not overwhelming but just enough.

I purchased this because my usual was out of stock, turns out I'm glad it was.  This body wash is extremely thick which of course leads to using less.  That combined with the great scent makes for my new go to body wash.
Love this stuff. It reminded me of my grandfather who was a leather wearing motorcycle riding Marlboro smoking son of a bitch. Loved that man!!

reviews.t: Smell greats and a little goes a long way...recommended
reviews.x: Smells like confidence, valor and style mixed together. A very unique and manly smell. A little goes a long way. I like it!
Great product love the smell but 50% cheaper to buy it at target
My wife really really loves this smell if you know what I mean.

I ordered the "Thick 70" direct from their website...shipping was supposed to be 5-7 days, and I received the package in 3.  Absolutely amazing stuff!!!  Great smell that is long lasting...will be purchasing again!
Big fan. I’d second the reviews that say “Stop looking. Start buying.” I’ve been trying lots of soaps. Bars and body washes. This is the first to impress me. Smells good, is moisturizing. Win win.
I like other Duke products this is not one. Really horrible smell. I don’t know how this product sells but would not buy again or recommend. Will try to return or just throw away.
Smells great. Gives you that "clean clean" feeling, without leaving your skin feeling like it's covered in lotion. Looking forward to getting a third bottle.
Want to smell like a man and not a pronoun? This is for you. Rugged, refreshing, and refined. Ladies love it

reviews.t: a company run by vets... what else is there tio say?!?!?

My ONLY complaint with this purchase is that I used to get it locally for about $8.99-$9.99 but it seems the local store is no longer selling it!?!?!? So, I purchased the same size bottle this time and it was ALOT more money! Im not sure why?? But any company that is veteran owned or donates to vets will always get my business. Im just very disapp

I got mine at target. I have a few of the other soaps and been happy with them. So on to purchasing this item I smelled it and was happy with the smell. Soon as I got home decided to try it out. It smelled totally different when actually used. The smell was so bad my wife couldn’t stand it. To be honest it smell like I don’t know what. I definitely don’t recommend.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the thick consistency, saying a little goes a long way.
The masculine, rustic scent (leather, tobacco, cedar) is a major selling point for many.
Some reviewers find the scent unpleasant or confusing, comparing it to a barn or cedar chips.
Several reviewers feel the product is overpriced or cheaper elsewhere.
Reviewers appreciate the large bottle size and value for the price.
